answer: Work waits on the cedar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
